siteConfig.title: Renewed Hope National Livestock Carnival 2026
siteConfig.subTitle: Golden Camel & Cow Carnival
siteConfig.tagline: Welcome to the Renewed Hope National Livestock Carnival 2026
siteConfig.description: Experience Nigeria's grandest celebration of culture, music, food, and farming - featuring royal horses, camels, championship cattle, open-flame suya, live concerts, and trade exhibitions.
siteConfig.venue: Abuja National Grounds (Old Parade Ground, FCT)

magazineRows.headline: Royal Horse Cavalry & Camel Parade
magazineRows.body: Witness over 200 ceremonial cavalry war stallions, traditional Northern horsemen, camel pageantry, and royal racing displays in a breathtaking celebration of national heritage.

magazineRows.headline: Open-Flame Suya Village & Artisanal Culinary Fest
magazineRows.body: Indulge in Nigeria's largest open-flame grilling arena. Featuring master Suya chefs, artisanal smoked meats, organic spice markets, and family festival dining.
magazineRows.imageAlt: Open-flame Suya Village and Culinary Pavilion

magazineRows.headline: Live Performances, Fashion & Cultural Arts
magazineRows.body: Immerse yourself in live music concerts, traditional masquerades including the monumental Ijele, contemporary African fashion showcases, and indigenous arts & crafts markets.
magazineRows.imageAlt: Cultural Arts and Ijele Masquerade in Abuja

magazineRows.headline: Agribusiness, Tech & Fashion Vendor Hub
magazineRows.body: Explore multi-sector commercial pavilions featuring high-tech agricultural machinery, digital livestock e-tagging platforms, clothing vendors, and direct B2B trade matchmaking.
magazineRows.imageAlt: Digital Traceability and Agribusiness Tech Hub

magazineRows.headline: National Champion Bull & Golden Camel Judging
magazineRows.body: Watch supreme livestock judging competitions, electronic live-weight trading demonstrations, and purebred genetics showcases from top pastoralists across the country.
